t: The most surprising thing said about repentance
a: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
p: …fa-ulā'ika yubaddilu-llāhu sayyi'ātihim ḥasanāt, wa kāna-llāhu Ghafūran Raḥīmā.
m: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
